body.statement: H4 setup frequency, not trade count: 55.65 pullbacks per year (167 in 3.0 years), monthly counts Poisson-like (dispersion 0.98); BL-01 discovery (1.5 years) should see about 83 pullbacks (90%: 68-98) and fewer trades, by an unmeasured pullback-to-trade conversion

not_evidence_for: presence or absence of an edge
changing BL-01 parameters or decision rules
body.statement: BL-01 as preregistered is a descriptive and feasibility run: under its own decision rule GO needs >= 60 trades, reached with probability 0.09 at conversion 0.6 and 0.81 at 0.8; with an 8-point true lift GO is 1-14%, INVESTIGATE 75-83% (conversion 0.6-0.8, month SD 0.05). The earlier 24%/372 figure used a different test (one-sample z on p_target_first, alpha 0.05/6, n=80 assumed trades, no costs)

assumptions.cost_r: 0.05 R round trip (median spread/ATR 0.046 at risk about 1 ATR); stress +0.10 R as in the rule
assumptions.decision_rule: BL01_DECISION_RULES_V1, direction/hour/cell checks not modelled (GO is an upper bound)
assumptions.dependence: month-level shift of p with SD 0.05 (also 0.10); month-clustered SE approximates the month-block bootstrap (checked: width ratio 0.98, CI-low 0.017 R lower on average)
assumptions.pullback_to_trade_conversion: unknown: 0.4 / 0.6 / 0.8 (needs M15 confirmation, risk filter, entry gap; measured by BL-01 itself, a structural not an outcome quantity)

conclusions: decision (max, 2026-10-11): preregistration kept unchanged; no period extension; minimum effect not raised; discovery reports descriptive results, a preliminary reading and feasibility only
discovery outcomes are never used to change parameters or to pick an effect size afterwards
limits: tick data only on the research PC; not run from the cloud container
power: under BL01_DECISION_RULES_V1 the discovery split is expected to give about 33-67 trades; GO is structurally unlikely below about 0.7 pullback-to-trade conversion (OBS-BL01-POWER-ANALYSIS-V1)
MDE of the CI criterion at 50 trades about 0.57 R net: only large effects are detectable
